summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Gladys Bronwyn Stern, also known as GB Stern, an English writer born Gladys "Bertha" Stern in London. It states her dates of birth and death and summarizes her output across several literary forms. The note contains no further details about her life or works.
one_line: Gladys Bronwyn Stern (GB Stern) was an English writer of novels, short stories, plays, memoirs, biographies and criticism, active 1890–1973.
key_facts: Gladys Bronwyn Stern, also known as GB Stern, was born 17 June 1890.
GB Stern was born Gladys "Bertha" Stern in London, England.
GB Stern wrote many short stories.
